## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 22, 2026 - Sep 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Taffyinator1901_, Sep 19, 2026, 1/5: "I have already paid for the premium membership for this app but it doesn’t remember that I have paid as every time I use the barcode scanner it keeps asking for me to pay again, getting a bit annoyed 😠 that I am paying for such a glitchy app!!!!!"
            2. _CyndySmith_, Sep 9, 2026, 1/5: "I signed up and paid £16, then tried to do meal planning and I need to pay another £20/month. Seriously?"
            3. _timbaa88_, Sep 1, 2026, 5/5: "I accidentally purchased the one-year subscription instead of the monthly option. Unfortunately, I only noticed my mistake when I checked the charge on my online banking account, less than 24 hours after making the purchase. I contacted customer support immediately and requested a refund so that I could repurchase the subscription using the monthly option instead. Unfortunately, my refund request was denied. I’m disappointed because this was a genuine mistake, reported very quickly, and I wasn’t asking to cancel my subscription altogether—I simply wanted the opportunity to switch to the monthly plan. I feel that a little more flexibility and understanding from customer support would have made a big difference. I don’t want to rate the app itself based on a bad experience caused by my own mistake, as I understand that I selected the wrong subscription option. However, considering I noticed the mistake and requested a refund in less than 24 hours, I feel they could have honoured the refund and allowed me to repurchase the monthly subscription instead."
